config.deepseekBalance.description: Fetch and show the DeepSeek balance using the key from the Kimi Code config.
config.restore.description: Reopen Kimi Code windows after a window reload if they were open before.
config.tabCompletionNotification.descrip: Show a notification when a Kimi agent turn finishes in a window (tab).
config.tabCompletionSound.description: Play a short chime when a Kimi agent turn finishes in a window (tab).
config.tabStatusMarkers.description: Prefix Kimi window titles with a status marker: [~] working, [V] done, [!] error, [?] waiting for your input.
config.statusbar.description: Show the Kimi Code button in the status bar (right side).
config.usageStatusbar.description: Show subscription usage percent in the status bar (updated every 5 minutes).
config.alerts.description: Notify when subscription usage crosses the alert thresholds (once per limit window).
config.alertMonth.description: Alert threshold for the monthly limit (fraction 0..1).
config.deepseekBelow.description: Warn when the DeepSeek balance falls below this amount (USD).
